subject: general
question: Which Indian government body was appointed as the overall Project Development Consultant (PDC) for the Port and Inland Water Transport (IWT) component of the Kaladan project?

options.text: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

solution:
The correct answer is __**Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI)**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI)** was appointed as the overall **Project Development Consultant (PDC)** by the **Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)** for the Port and **Inland Water Transport (IWT)** component of the **Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project (KMMTTP)**.

• The **Port and IWT** component of the project includes the construction of a **deep-water port** at **Sittwe**, a **river terminal** at **Paletwa**, and the **dredging** of the **Kaladan River** to maintain a navigable channel.

• As the **PDC**, **IWAI** was responsible for the **supervision**, **monitoring**, and **technical consultancy** of the maritime and riverine infrastructure development in **Myanmar**.
